Create precisely aligned 3 by 3 contact sheet of NINE independent square Japanese children's educational watercolor illustrations. EXACT equal cells with white narrow gutters at one-third and two-thirds horizontally and vertically. Generous margin inside cells, complete unclipped subjects, clean anatomy, no text, no labels. Row-major:
1 two-part story inside cell: child accidentally tears friend's picture and looks sorry; then spends effort repairing damaged picture with paper and colors, friend happy, making up for damage, no money.
2 recognizable WATER in glass being poured, ORANGE JUICE pouring from carton into glass, and COOKING OIL golden liquid being poured from bottle into pan, all together, liquid everyday examples, no oil barrels or unsafe gasoline handling.
3 two sequential calendar pages LEFT earlier sunny date marked planned sports day and RIGHT later rainy planned date shifted even later; prominent red arrow LEFT to RIGHT from earlier date to later date within same calendar, arrowhead ends at later date, simple dates 10 and 17 if needed.
4 child gently declines another helping of vegetables by politely gesturing a SMALL serving with hands and gentle apologetic face instead of blunt rejection; parent understands, tactful indirect wording illustrated by tiny-serving thought bubble and remaining full plate.
5 diagram on plain white background: central dot, three red arrows starting near dot and radiating straight OUTWARD, arrowheads at outer ends; no circular arrows, NO text, illustrates direction away from center not forces.
6 extension cord connecting wall socket to table lamp far away, clear cable and connected plug/socket fully visible, unplugged shorter cable shown beside for comparison, safe no exposed wire.
7 many children at school festival, varied friendly faces with normal eyes, all entirely within cell, single crowd scene, no stray bottom fragments.
8 before and after shop display for one apple: LEFT price 100 coins represented as ten stacks of ten dots; RIGHT price only 50 coins represented as five stacks of ten dots, large downward arrow and apple in both views, clearly large decrease in price. use concise 100 and 50 numerals if needed.
9 close view two children warmly smiling with natural symmetrical pupils, gentle cute appearance, cheerful happy expressions, no strange eyes, clean simple background.
